def num(n) = [:n, n]
def txt(s) = [:s, s]
def err(s) = [:e, s]
def ref(c, r, f = 0) = [:r, c, r, f]
def idx(r) = r[2] * 26 + r[1]
def label(i) = (65 + i % 26).chr + (i / 26 + 1).to_s
def inside(r) = (0...26).cover?(r[1]) && (0...99).cover?(r[2])
def area_pair(a, b)
  c, r, f = a[1..]
  d, t, g = b[1..]
  ac, ar, bc, br = f & 1, f & 2, g & 1, g & 2
  if c > d
    c, d, ac, bc = d, c, bc, ac
  end

  if r > t
    r, t, ar, br = t, r, br, ar
  end

  [:g, ref(c, r, ac | ar), ref(d, t, bc | br)]
end

def address(s)
  raise "bad address" unless /\A[A-Z][1-9][0-9]?\z/.match?(s)
  ref(s.getbyte(0) - 65, s[1..].to_i - 1)
end

def area(s)
  parts = s.split(":", -1)
  raise "bad address" if parts.size > 2
  a = address(parts[0])
  b = parts.size == 1 ? a : address(parts[1])
  area_pair(a, b)
end

def cells(g)
  (g[1][2]..g[2][2]).flat_map { |r| (g[1][1]..g[2][1]).map { |c| r * 26 + c } }
end

def contains(g, r) = (g[1][1]..g[2][1]).cover?(r[1]) && (g[1][2]..g[2][2]).cover?(r[2])
LEVELS = [%w[= <> < <= > >=], ["&"], %w[+ -], %w[* /]].freeze
def prec(op) = LEVELS.index { |xs| xs.include?(op) }

class Parser
  def syntax(p) = raise "syntax error at #{p}"
  def initialize(s)
    @tokens = []
    i = 1
    while i < s.size
      p = i + 1
      ch = s[i]
      if ch == " "
        i += 1
        next
      end

      if /[0-9]/.match?(ch)
        word = s[i..][/\A[0-9]+/]
        syntax(p) if word.size >= 10
        @tokens << [num(word.to_i), p]
        i += word.size
      elsif ch == "\""
        j = s.index("\"", i + 1)
        syntax(p) unless j
        @tokens << [txt(s[i + 1...j]), p]
        i = j + 1
      elsif /[A-Za-z$]/.match?(ch)
        word = s[i..][/\A[A-Za-z0-9$]+/].upcase
        i += word.size
        if (m = /\A(\$?)([A-Z])(\$?)([1-9][0-9]?)\z/.match(word))
          x = ref(m[2].ord - 65, m[4].to_i - 1, (m[1].empty? ? 0 : 1) | (m[3].empty? ? 0 : 2))
        elsif /\A[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*\z/.match?(word)
          x = [s[i..].lstrip.start_with?("(") ? :c : :w, word]
        else
          syntax(p)
        end

        @tokens << [x, p]
      else
        op = s[i, 2]
        op = ch unless %w[<> <= >=].include?(op)
        syntax(p) unless "+-*/&(),:=<>".include?(ch)
        @tokens << [[:t, op], p]
        i += op.size
      end
    end

    @tokens << [[:end], s.size + 1]
    @at = 0
  end

  def take(op)
    if @tokens[@at][0] == [:t, op]
      @at += 1
      true
    else
      false
    end
  end

  def expect(op)
    syntax(@tokens[@at][1]) unless take(op)
  end

  def expression(level = 0)
    return primary if level == 4
    a = expression(level + 1)
    while @tokens[@at][0][0] == :t && LEVELS[level].include?(@tokens[@at][0][1])
      op = @tokens[@at][0][1]
      @at += 1
      a = [:b, op, a, expression(level + 1)]
    end

    a
  end

  def primary
    return [:u, primary] if take("-")
    x, p = @tokens[@at]
    @at += 1
    case x[0]
    when :n, :s, :w
      x
    when :r
      return x unless take(":")
      syntax(@tokens[@at][1]) unless @tokens[@at][0][0] == :r
      y = @tokens[@at][0]
      @at += 1
      area_pair(x, y)
    when :c
      expect("(")
      args = []
      unless take(")")
        args << expression
        args << expression while take(",")
        expect(")")
      end

      [:f, x[1], args]
    when :t
      syntax(p) unless x[1] == "("
      a = expression
      expect(")")
      a
    else
      syntax(p)
    end
  end

  def parse
    tree = expression
    syntax(@tokens[@at][1]) unless @tokens[@at][0][0] == :end
    tree
  end
end

def canonical(x)
  case x[0]
  when :n
    x[1].to_s
  when :s
    "\"" + x[1] + "\""
  when :w
    x[1]
  when :x
    "#REF!"
  when :r
    (x[3] & 1 == 0 ? "" : "$") + (65 + x[1]).chr + (x[3] & 2 == 0 ? "" : "$") + (x[2] + 1).to_s
  when :g
    canonical(x[1]) + ":" + canonical(x[2])
  when :f
    x[1] + "(" + x[2].map { |a| canonical(a) }.join(",") + ")"
  when :u
    "-" + (x[1][0] == :b ? "(" + canonical(x[1]) + ")" : canonical(x[1]))
  when :b
    a, b = canonical(x[2]), canonical(x[3])
    a = "(" + a + ")" if x[2][0] == :b && prec(x[2][1]) < prec(x[1])
    b = "(" + b + ")" if x[3][0] == :b && prec(x[3][1]) <= prec(x[1])
    a + x[1] + b
  end
end

def display(x) = x.nil? ? "" : x[1].to_s
def notation(x) = x.nil? ? "(empty)" : x[0] == :"=" ? "=" + canonical(x[1]) : x[0] == :s ? "\"" + x[1] + "\"" : display(
  x
)
def to_number(x) = x.nil? ? num(0) : %i[s g].include?(x[0]) ? err("#VALUE!") : x
def to_string(x) = x.nil? ? txt("") : x[0] == :n ? txt(x[1].to_s) : x[0] == :g ? err("#VALUE!") : x
def quotient(a, b) = (a < 0) == (b < 0) ? a.abs / b.abs : -(a.abs / b.abs)
def rewrite(x, &f)
  return nil unless x
  case x[0]
  when :r, :g
    f.call(x)
  when :f
    [:f, x[1], x[2].map { |a| rewrite(a, &f) }]
  when :b
    [:b, x[1], rewrite(x[2], &f), rewrite(x[3], &f)]
  when :u, :"="
    [x[0], rewrite(x[1], &f)]
  else
    x
  end
end

def dependencies(x, out = {})
  return out unless x
  case x[0]
  when :r
    out[idx(x)] = true
  when :g
    cells(x).each { |i| out[i] = true }
  when :f
    x[2].each { |a| dependencies(a, out) }
  when :b
    dependencies(x[2], out)
    dependencies(x[3], out)
  when :u, :"="
    dependencies(x[1], out)
  end

  out
end

class Sheet
  def initialize
    @contents = Array.new(2574)
    @values = @contents.dup
    @deps = Array.new(2574) { {} }
    @history = []
  end

  def evaluate(x)
    case x[0]
    when :n, :s, :g
      x
    when :r
      @values[idx(x)]
    when :w
      err("#NAME?")
    when :x
      err("#REF!")
    when :u
      a = to_number(evaluate(x[1]))
      a[0] == :e ? a : num(-a[1])
    when :b
      a, b = evaluate(x[2]), evaluate(x[3])
      return a if a&.first == :e
      return b if b&.first == :e
      op = x[1]
      if prec(op) == 0
        return err("#VALUE!") if a&.first == :g || b&.first == :g
        blank = a&.first == :s || b&.first == :s ? txt("") : num(0)
        a ||= blank
        b ||= blank
        c = a[0] != b[0] ? (a[0] == :n ? -1 : 1) : a[1] <=> b[1]
        return num(
          (
            case op
            when "="
              c == 0
            when "<>"
              c != 0
            when "<"
              c < 0
            when "<="
              c <= 0
            when ">"
              c > 0
            else
              c >= 0
            end
          ) ? 1 : 0
        )
      end

      a, b = op == "&" ? [to_string(a), to_string(b)] : [to_number(a), to_number(b)]
      return a if a[0] == :e
      return b if b[0] == :e
      case op
      when "&"
        txt(a[1] + b[1])
      when "+"
        num(a[1] + b[1])
      when "-"
        num(a[1] - b[1])
      when "*"
        num(a[1] * b[1])
      else
        b[1] == 0 ? err("#DIV/0!") : num(quotient(a[1], b[1]))
      end

    when :f
      call(x[1], x[2])
    end
  end

  def call(name, args)
    if %w[SUM MIN MAX COUNT AVERAGE AND OR CONCAT].include?(name)
      return err("#VALUE!") if args.empty?
      items = args.flat_map { |a|
        v = evaluate(a)
        v&.first == :g ? cells(v).map { |i| @values[i] } : [v]
      }
      ns = items.select { |a| a&.first == :n }.map { |a| a[1] }
      return num(ns.size) if name == "COUNT"
      error = items.find { |a| a&.first == :e }
      return error if error
      case name
      when "SUM"
        num(ns.sum)
      when "MIN"
        num(ns.min || 0)
      when "MAX"
        num(ns.max || 0)
      when "AVERAGE"
        ns.empty? ? err("#DIV/0!") : num(quotient(ns.sum, ns.size))
      when "AND"
        ns.empty? ? err("#VALUE!") : num(ns.all? { |n| n != 0 } ? 1 : 0)
      when "OR"
        ns.empty? ? err("#VALUE!") : num(ns.any? { |n| n != 0 } ? 1 : 0)
      else
        txt(items.map { |a| to_string(a)[1] }.join)
      end
    elsif name == "IF"
      return err("#VALUE!") unless [2, 3].include?(args.size)
      c = to_number(evaluate(args[0]))
      return c if c[0] == :e
      c[1] != 0 ? evaluate(args[1]) : args.size == 3 ? evaluate(args[2]) : num(0)
    elsif %w[ABS NOT LEN].include?(name)
      return err("#VALUE!") unless args.size == 1
      v = evaluate(args[0])
      v = name == "LEN" ? to_string(v) : to_number(v)
      return v if v[0] == :e
      num(name == "LEN" ? v[1].size : name == "ABS" ? v[1].abs : v[1] == 0 ? 1 : 0)
    else
      err("#NAME?")
    end
  end

  def recalculate
    @deps = @contents.map { |x| x&.first == :"=" ? dependencies(x[1]) : {} }
    @values = @contents.map { |x| x&.first == :"=" ? nil : x }
    indices = {}
    low = {}
    stack = []
    on = {}
    cyclic = {}
    visit = lambda do |i|
      indices[i] = low[i] = indices.size
      stack << i
      on[i] = true
      @deps[i].each_key do |j|
        next unless @contents[j]&.first == :"="
        if !indices.key?(j)
          visit.call(j)
          low[i] = [low[i], low[j]].min
        elsif on[j]
          low[i] = [low[i], indices[j]].min
        end
      end

      if low[i] == indices[i]
        part = []
        loop {
          j = stack.pop
          on.delete(j)
          part << j
          break if j == i
        }
        part.each { |j| cyclic[j] = true } if part.size > 1 || @deps[i].key?(i)
      end
    end

    @contents.each_index { |i| visit.call(i) if @contents[i]&.first == :"=" && !indices.key?(i) }
    done = {}
    calculate = lambda do |i|
      return unless @contents[i]&.first == :"=" && !done[i]
      done[i] = true
      if cyclic[i]
        @values[i] = err("#CYCLE!")
        return
      end

      @deps[i].each_key { |j| calculate.call(j) }
      v = evaluate(@contents[i][1])
      @values[i] = v.nil? ? num(0) : v[0] == :g ? err("#VALUE!") : v
    end

    @contents.each_index { |i| calculate.call(i) }
  end

  def replace(next_contents)
    old = @values
    @contents = next_contents
    recalculate
    old.each_index.count { |i| old[i] != @values[i] }
  end

  def describe(i) = "#{label(i)}: #{notation(@contents[i])} -> #{notation(@values[i])}"
  def execute(line)
    name, rest = line.split(" ", 2)
    case name
    when "SHOW"
      return [describe(idx(address(rest)))]
    when "LIST"
      out = @contents.each_index.filter_map { |i| describe(i) if @contents[i] }
      return out.empty? ? ["(no cells)"] : out
    when "DEPS"
      i = idx(address(rest))
      format = -> (xs) { xs.empty? ? "none" : xs.sort.map { |j| label(j) }.join(",") }
      return [
        "#{rest}: precedents=#{format.call(@deps[i].keys)} dependents=#{format.call(@deps.each_index.select { |j| @deps[j].key?(i) })}"
      ]
    when "PRINT"
      g = area(rest)
      rs = g[1][2]..g[2][2]
      cs = g[1][1]..g[2][1]
      rw = (g[2][2] + 1).to_s.size
      ws = cs.map { |c| [1, *rs.map { |r| display(@values[r * 26 + c]).size }].max }
      sep = "+" + "-" * rw + "+" + ws.map { |w| "-" * w + "+" }.join
      out = [sep, "|" + " " * rw + "|" + cs.each_with_index.map { |c, j| (65 + c).chr.ljust(ws[j]) + "|" }.join, sep]
      rs.each { |r|
        out <<
          "|" +
          (r + 1).to_s.rjust(rw) +
          "|" +
          cs
            .each_with_index
            .map { |c, j|
              v = @values[r * 26 + c]
              (v&.first == :n ? display(v).rjust(ws[j]) : display(v).ljust(ws[j])) + "|"
            }
            .join
      }
      return out << sep
    when "UNDO"
      raise "nothing to undo" if @history.empty?
      command, old = @history.pop
      return ["UNDO #{command} changed=#{replace(old)}"]
    end

    next_contents = @contents.dup
    target = nil
    case name
    when "SET"
      a, s = rest.split(" ", 2)
      target = idx(address(a))
      next_contents[target] = if s.start_with?("=")
        [:"=", Parser.new(s).parse]
      elsif /\A"[^"]*"\z/.match?(s)
        txt(s[1...-1])
      elsif /\A(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,8})\z/.match?(s)
        num(s.to_i)
      else
        raise "bad value"
      end

    when "CLEAR"
      cells(area(rest)).each { |i| next_contents[i] = nil }
    when "COPY", "MOVE"
      a, b = rest.split(" ")
      source = area(a)
      dest = address(b)
      dc = dest[1] - source[1][1]
      dr = dest[2] - source[1][2]
      shift = -> (r, rel) { ref(r[1] + (rel && r[3] & 1 != 0 ? 0 : dc), r[2] + (rel && r[3] & 2 != 0 ? 0 : dr), r[3]) }
      destination = area_pair(shift.call(source[1], false), shift.call(source[2], false))
      raise "out of grid" unless inside(destination[1]) && inside(destination[2])
      transform = lambda do |x|
        if x[0] == :r
          if name == "COPY"
            r = shift.call(x, true)
            inside(r) ? r : [:x]
          else
            contains(source, x) ? shift.call(x, false) : contains(destination, x) ? [:x] : x
          end
        elsif name == "MOVE" && !(contains(source, x[1]) && contains(source, x[2]))
          x
        else
          a = shift.call(x[1], name == "COPY")
          b = shift.call(x[2], name == "COPY")
          inside(a) && inside(b) ? area_pair(a, b) : [:x]
        end
      end

      next_contents.map! { |x| rewrite(x, &transform) } if name == "MOVE"
      moving = cells(source).map { |i| [i, name == "COPY" ? rewrite(@contents[i], &transform) : next_contents[i]] }
      moving.each { |i, _| next_contents[i] = nil } if name == "MOVE"
      moving.each { |i, x| next_contents[i + dr * 26 + dc] = x }
    when "INSERTROW", "DELETEROW", "INSERTCOL", "DELETECOL"
      row = name.end_with?("ROW")
      insert = name.start_with?("INSERT")
      raise "bad address" unless (row ? /\A[1-9][0-9]?\z/ : /\A[A-Z]\z/).match?(rest)
      at = row ? rest.to_i - 1 : rest.ord - 65
      limit = row ? 99 : 26
      axis = -> (x) { x[row ? 2 : 1] }
      change = -> (x, v) { row ? ref(x[1], v, x[3]) : ref(v, x[2], x[3]) }
      if insert && @contents.each_index.any? { |i| @contents[i] && (row ? i / 26 : i % 26) == limit - 1 }
        raise "last #{row ? "row" : "column"} not empty"
      end

      transform = lambda do |x|
        if x[0] == :r
          v = axis.call(x)
          if !insert && v == at
            [:x]
          else
            n = v + (insert ? (v >= at ? 1 : 0) : (v > at ? -1 : 0))
            n >= limit ? [:x] : change.call(x, n)
          end
        else
          a = axis.call(x[1])
          b = axis.call(x[2])
          u = a + (insert ? (a >= at ? 1 : 0) : (a > at ? -1 : 0))
          v = b + (insert ? (b >= at ? 1 : 0) : (b >= at ? -1 : 0))
          (!insert && a == at && b == at) || v >= limit ? [:x] : area_pair(change.call(x[1], u), change.call(x[2], v))
        end
      end

      next_contents = Array.new(2574)
      @contents.each_index do |i|
        next unless @contents[i]
        r = ref(i % 26, i / 26)
        v = axis.call(r)
        next if !insert && v == at
        t = change.call(r, v + (insert ? (v >= at ? 1 : 0) : (v > at ? -1 : 0)))
        next_contents[idx(t)] = rewrite(@contents[i], &transform)
      end
    else
      raise "unknown command"
    end

    @history << [name, @contents]
    changed = replace(next_contents)
    [name + (name == "SET" ? " #{label(target)}=#{notation(@values[target])}" : "") + " changed=#{changed}"]
  end
end

n = STDIN.gets.to_i
sheet = Sheet.new
n.times do
  begin
    puts(sheet.execute(STDIN.gets.chomp))
  rescue RuntimeError => e
    puts("ERROR #{e.message}")
  end
end
